description.value: If you're reduced to 0 hit points without being killed outright and still have at least one tech point, you may, at no action cost, spend every remaining tech point to instead drop to 1 hit point. Doing so forces every creature within 30 feet to make a Dexterity save against your tech save DC, taking 1d12 acid, cold, fire, ion, or lightning damage (your choice) for each tech point you spent on a failure, or half that on a success.
